propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires the MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation actually scans all history reachable from current HEAD regardless of merge status
The referencing-commit precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as unconditional
The precheck accepts any transitive descendant of the ticket (via list_descendants) in the referencing commit, not just the ticket itself, and this is undocumented

The rebar transition --ref flag enables closing stacked stories against their own commit without moving the worktree, but AGENTS.md never mentions it despite it being documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md
The land-before-close ordering rule is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck mechanism, but the docs attribute it to the precheck instead
